_note: dev-plan §3.1, in dropdown order. Rates are defaults and are edited per quote; where a charge appears at several rates in the samples the most recent is used here. POLISH has no flat rate: it is Rs 1 per mm of glass thickness per running foot, so the app fills in thickness x ratePerThicknessMm when it is added to a section, and the operator edits from there. basis only decides where a charge starts: per_unit charges open with a count of one, flat charges open with no count and the rate is the whole charge. Every charge is taxed with the glass it belongs to.
